import csv
import io

p = '/home/aj/Projects/strix-halo-johnny/docs/cis-26.04-l1-results.csv'
new = dict()
new['3.3.1.16'] = ('PASS', 'running 1; net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians = 1 at line 22 of /etc/sysctl.d/60-johnny-cis-network.conf; matching line in /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf commented (line 29) so ufw enable does not force 0 (batch-6.sh 2026-11-04)')
new['3.3.1.17'] = ('PASS', 'running 1; net.ipv4.conf.default.log_martians = 1 at line 23 of /etc/sysctl.d/60-johnny-cis-network.conf; matching line in /etc/ufw/sysctl.conf commented (line 30) so ufw enable does not force 0 (batch-6.sh 2026-11-04)')
new['4.1.2'] = ('PASS', 'ufw status: Status: active; Logging: on (low); ufw.conf ENABLED=yes (enabled_file=yes); ufw.service enabled; one user rule: ufw allow in on eno3 from 192.168.50.0/24 to any port 22 proto tcp; rollback timer inactive (batch-6.sh 2026-11-04)')
new['4.1.3'] = ('PASS', 'ufw status verbose: Default: deny (incoming), allow (outgoing), disabled (routed); input_drop=1 (batch-6.sh 2026-11-04)')
new['4.1.5'] = ('PASS (manual)', 'ufw status verbose: Default ... disabled (routed); ip_forward=0; DEFAULT_FORWARD_POLICY not printed this run (DROP when read 2026-10-31); /etc/default/ufw sha256 07db07bb07e5ac1388707b7c59dabfbce8ad06d5001236248fbf3f93b79c2ed7 (batch-6.sh 2026-11-04)')
out = []
for line in open(p).read().split('\n'):
    row = next(csv.reader([line])) if line else None
    if row and row[0] in new:
        res, ev = new[row[0]]
        buf = io.StringIO()
        csv.writer(buf, lineterminator='', quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL).writerow([row[0], row[1], row[2], res, ev, '2026-11-04'])
        line = buf.getvalue()
    out.append(line)
open(p, 'w').write('\n'.join(out))
